# Health Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened related to Health.

## Scope note

Broader concept for all tracked health data points (GlucoseEvent, InsulinEvent, BloodPressureEvent, EKGEvent); populates DayClusterHealth and rolls up into WeekHealth/WeekDiabetes.

- [Event](../Event/) — generic (ISO 25964)
